scientific_integrity: The claim is established analytically with exact matrix formulas, a monotonicity proof and a cubic coefficient argument, with standalone exact-rational and high-precision computational corroboration. The row/column convention and required pulse ordering are explicitly fixed. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The complete iff threshold applies to nonoverlapping reverse-ordered four-state unit integrated-rate pulses of equal strength and to the two-term right-acting Magnus logarithm. General dimension and unequal strengths give only local small-rate failure; not a large-rate positivity or accuracy guarantee. The publication-overlap assessment is limited to identified relevant literature.
title: A sharp four-state positivity-recovery threshold for the two-term Magnus exponential
